rules.title: Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.requirement: The allowable annual rent increase is 1.6% for the period from March 1, 2026, to February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Applies generally under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance.

rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board Current Rates

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits at the rate of 4.2% for the period from March 1, 2026, to February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential security deposits held under city rules.

rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board Current Rates

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Certain Evictions
rules.requirement: For evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, landlords must pay relocation amounts of $8,245.00 per tenant up to a maximum of $24,733.00 per unit, plus an additional $5,497.00 for each elderly or disabled tenant or household with minor children, effective March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Applies to specific no-fault evictions such as owner move-in or demolition.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: For tenants evicted under the Ellis Act, landlords must pay relocation amounts of $11,110.05 per tenant up to a maximum of $33,330.13 per unit, plus an additional $7,443.90 for each elderly or disabled tenant, effective March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Applies to evictions under the Ellis Act.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement Under 20 Days
rules.requirement: For temporary displacement for less than 20 days, the relocation payment is $446.00 per day plus actual moving expenses for the period from March 1, 2026, to February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Applies to temporary displacement lasting less than 20 days.

rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board Current Rates
